title: Senior Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales)
Senior Cloud Infrastructure and Reliability Solutions Architect
description_html: NVIDIA is looking for a Day 2 Site Reliability Engineer to join the EMEA NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) Day 1 / Day 2 Operations team. EMEA NCP fleets are scaling towards a million deployed GPUs, and this role exists to keep those fleets running at maximum goodput once they are in production — owning fault detection and remediation, preventive maintenance, and proactive firmware and field-notice rollout across partner estates.    We are looking for a hands-on reliability engineer who thinks in SLOs, error budgets and blast radius rather than tickets. You will measure and drive MTBI and job goodput on multi-thousand-GPU clusters, automate the detection-to-remediation loop, and work directly with NCP operations teams, NVEX and TAMs to review incidents and escalations and turn each one into a permanent fix.  NCP estates are open-source-first, home-grown and heterogeneous — upstream Kubernetes, KubeVirt, Slurm, Prometheus/Grafana, Cumulus/SONiC and a long tail of ISV and in-house tooling — so this role is deliberately tool-agnostic: you will meet each partner on the stack they actually run rather than on a single proprietary product, and you will keep GPU capacity generating revenue instead of burning cost in reactive support.     What You’ll Be Doing:     Own Day 2 production stability and reliability at fleet scale across EMEA NCP partners: define, measure and improve MTBI and job goodput on multi-thousand-GPU clusters, and hold the error budget for the platforms you support.    Build and operate the fault detection to remediation loop—GPU, node, fabric and storage fault signatures, automated triage, node drain, cordon, reset and return-to-service workflows—so failures are caught and cleared before they cost training jobs.    Run preventive maintenance and proactive firmware and field-notice rollout campaigns across partner fleets (e.g. CPLD and switch firmware levels), including risk assessment, staged rollout, maintenance-window planning and verification at scale.    Own observability and reliability tooling for GPU fleets: Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, DCGM and XID diagnostics, node-level health agents such as GPUd and NVSentinel, and fleet-wide reliability intelligence—extending or integrating them into the partner’s own home-grown stack.    Lead incident response and post-incident review in collaboration with NVEX, TAM and partner operations teams: drive root-cause analysis on escalations, track corrective actions to closure, and convert every recurring incident into automation, a health check or a runbook.    Own Kubernetes node lifecycle and reliability engineering on heterogeneous open stacks—upstream Kubernetes, KubeVirt, Slurm and GPU-aware schedulers—covering node health policy, upgrade and reboot orchestration, and safe workload draining on GPU-accelerated nodes.       What We Need to See:     BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent experience.    8+ years in SRE, production engineering or large-scale infrastructure operations roles.    Reliability Engineering Practice: Demonstrated ownership of production reliability at scale—SLO and error-budget definition, on-call and incident command, blameless post-incident review, and measurable improvement of availability or mean time between interruptions.    GPU & HPC Fleet Operations: Hands-on experience operating HPC/AI clusters and NVIDIA GPU-accelerated infrastructure—driver and CUDA toolkit lifecycle, firmware management, workload profiling, and troubleshooting across CPUs, GPUs and high-speed interconnects.    Kubernetes at Scale: Extensive expertise in running Kubernetes in GPU-accelerated and HPC environments—node lifecycle, upgrades and draining, scheduler behaviour, batch schedulers such as Slurm, and mixed bare-metal/virtualised (e.g. KubeVirt) multi-tenant estates.    Observability & Automation: Proficiency in Python and Bash, Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management (e.g. Ansible, Terraform), GitOps-based fleet lifecycle and upgrade management, and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) for monitoring, alerting and building fault-tolerant systems.    Linux, Storage & Networking Fundamentals: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat, Ubuntu), OS-level tuning and security, data centre networking fundamentals, and parallel/enterprise storage (Lustre, GPFS, ZFS, XFS) as they affect cluster stability.       Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:     Experience defining and running proactive firmware, microcode or field-notice rollout campaigns across a large production fleet.    Familiarity with GPU health and fleet telemetry tooling—DCGM and XID diagnostics, GPUd, NVSentinel, node-level health agents and fleet-wide reliability intelligence.    Experience with the NVIDIA GPU and Network Operators for automated GPU and network resource lifecycle management in Kubernetes, and with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for provisioning and monitoring GPU clusters at scale.    Practical background in AI-native scheduling and inference frameworks on Kubernetes (e.g. KAI, Grove, Dynamo, NVIDIA Cloud Functions) and their failure modes under load.    Expertise in RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments. Exposure to Cumulus Linux, SONiC or Spectrum-X fabrics, DPU/DOCA infrastructure services, and NVLink/NVSwitch partition operations (NMX-C / NMX-M) on NVL72-class systems is a strong plus.

title: Platform Engineer - Compute
description_html:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute team. This team owns the critical systems that power project provisioning, scaling, and the compute that our users rely on every day.

You’ll work on the core platform that ensures Supabase can seamlessly scale
across multiple regions, handle high-volume workloads, and provide
low-latency, highly available compute services.

You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly
automated — enabling us to provision new projects reliably at scale,
optimize resource utilization, and deliver a seamless experience to the
millions of databases which we manage.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

 - Help build and maintain the Supabase Cloud offering;

 - Design and implement systems to provision, scale, and manage the multi-region compute workloads powering Supabase projects;

 - Own the full lifecycle of compute orchestration: project creation, warm pools, autoscaling, resizing, and resource optimization;

 - Improve automation and observability across the compute stack to ensure high availability and performance;

 - Improve our system architecture to reduce costs while balancing security, reliability, and performance;

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to help leverage compute as a core platform offering;

 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews;

 - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

 - Experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

 - Have 5+ years experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS required, additional experience with GCP and Azure is a plus) - particularly compute, networking, and storage services;

 - Have 3+ years experience working with building custom Kubernetes controllers, and operating large-scale (tens-to-hundreds of thousands of pods) clusters;

 - Are knowledgable about networking and multi-region infrastructure design;

 - Are familiar with Postgres;

 - Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi highly preferred, Terraform/CDK etc acceptable)

 - Have experience working with QEMU, KVM, and NAS is a plus;

 - Have experience with being part of on-call rotations for large production system;


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
